fields.statement: At 87e2c0a I built rhiza with go build outside PATH and, in a scratch git repo with a change set and a one-step command workflow (RHIZA_ROOT/CHANGE/RUN unset), ran run start --workflow one inside this agent session: exit 2, 'run start refused: this is agent session 46d3a9a6-9056-4c25-beb7-01a18aff4b33, and no agent session starts a run' with next 'ask the owner to run it outside an agent session'; the same with --json and with api call run.start (a usage error naming the session), and with --dry-run. No .git/rhiza was created and git worktree list showed no run worktree. With RHIZA_SESSION unset the same start ran step a, succeeded, wrote .git/rhiza/runs/<id>.jsonl and the cs/run-starts worktree; a later start inside the session was still refused with no new journal. A whitespace-only RHIZA_SESSION counts as no session. go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/run-start-agent-session passed.

At 87e2c0a the built binary's rhiza guide build shows, in the Verifier section, 'Test runs with fakes only, never real Rex, agents or `gh`.' go test ./internal/guide -run 'TestBuildText|TestReviewText|Cap' -count=1 -v passed, TestBuildText included, with build at 586 tokens under the cap of 800.

At 87e2c0a the built binary's rhiza guide review shows 'Every check except `qa` tests runs with fakes only, never real Rex, agents or `gh`.' at the head of the Checks list, and the qa line still says hands-on with the built binary, fakes alone do not count. go test ./internal/guide -run 'TestBuildText|TestReviewText|Cap' -count=1 -v passed, TestReviewText included, with review at 728 tokens under the cap of 800.
